greeting: ^Oh! Salutations, Barrington. Beautiful day for a climb, isn’t it! Feels more peaceful than usual.
^Speaking of climbs, I was just trying to figure out how to progress up this incline here! I want to get a better look at those clouds.
^They look light and fluffy now, the sign of a sunny day! I want to go get some notes on the structure!
^I saw you knock over that container of bubbles into the pond below! If only we could find a way to move this platform...
^Say, why don't we test out one of my new levers!
